name: Lugaid mac Casrubae
text: Lugaid mac Casrubae is a shadowy father figure in the Ulster Cycle. The sources give him one role only. He fathered Dubthach Dóeltenga, an Ulster Cycle warrior famed for his sharp tongue. Commentators warn that readers may confuse him with Lugaid Riab nDerg, a better-attested namesake.

attributes.attribute: Ulster Cycle tradition names him father of Dubthach Dóeltenga.
Commentators read the figure as possibly confused with Lugaid Riab nDerg.

okr.objective: Documents the minor Ulster Cycle figure Lugaid mac Casrubae, remembered as father of Dubthach Dóeltenga.
key_results: Dubthach Dóeltenga, a warrior known for his sharp tongue, is his son.
His sole attested role sits inside the Ulster Cycle.
Commentators flag possible confusion with Lugaid Riab nDerg.
